title: Battery Temperature Monitoring
text: Monitor for battery temperature, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Specify input as [Min,Max]} sets the option to specify input as minimum and maximum, {Undertemperature limit}, {Overtemperature limit}, {Qualification time undertemperature (s)} sets the undertemperature qualification time, {Disqualification time undertemperature (s)} sets the undertemperature disqualification time, {Qualification time overtemperature (s)} sets the overtemperature qualification time, {Disqualification time overtemperature (s)} sets the overtemperature disqualification time and {Algorithm data type} sets the option to choose data type for block algorithm. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Specify input as [Min,Max]
params.values: Option to specify input as minimum and maximum values off (default) | on

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
